sŭper-nŭmĕrārĭus , a, um, adj.,
I.supernumerary (post-class.): accensi, hoc est postea additi, quam fuisset legio completa, quos nunc supernumerarios vocant, Veg. Mil. 2, 19 fin.; Aug. in Psa. 146, 9.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
